server.sill.529e004a8653:
Sill · 窗台本地操作
  node scripts/sill.ts capabilities
  node scripts/sill.ts list [关键词]
  node scripts/sill.ts get <卡片ID>
  node scripts/sill.ts open <卡片ID>
  node scripts/sill.ts state
  node scripts/sill.ts apply [--file JSON文件]
apply 输入：{operations:[...],expectedRevision?:number}；无 --file 时从 stdin 读取 JSON。
